title: An Open-Label Extension Study to Evaluate Inhaled Treprostinil SMI in Participants With Pulmonary Hypertension Associated With Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease (PH-COPD)
official: An Open-label Extension Study of Treprostinil Administered Via a Soft Mist Inhaler (SMI) in Participants With Pulmonary Hypertension Associated With Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease (PH-COPD)
summary: The purpose of this study is to evaluate the long-term impact of treprostinil SMI on safety and efficacy by providing it to PH-COPD patients who participated in a preceding Phase 2 or 3 study.
conditions: Pulmonary Hypertension Associated With Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

1. Voluntarily give informed consent to participate in the study
2. Willing and able to comply with scheduled study visits, study treatment, laboratory tests, and all other study-related procedures
3. Enrolled in a previous study evaluating treprostinil SMI for PH-COPD, remained on study drug, and completed the study OR Enrolled in a previous study evaluating treprostinil SMI for PH-COPD when the study was discontinued by the Sponsor for reasons other than safety
4. Women of childbearing potential (WOCBP) must be nonpregnant (as confirmed by a pregnancy test at study entry) and nonlactating and agree to use 1 of the following:

   1. Abstain from penile-vaginal intercourse (when it is in line with their preferred and usual lifestyle) OR
   2. Use medically acceptable, highly effective contraception for the duration of the study and at least 30 days after discontinuing study drug.

   Medically acceptable, highly effective forms of contraception include approved hormonal contraceptives (oral, injectable, transdermal, intravaginal, and implantable), hormonal or non-hormonal intrauterine devices or systems, or monogamous intercourse with a partner who has undergone vasectomy. Barrier methods alone or with spermicide may be considered with Sponsor approval, if they have a proven track record of excellent compliance. Note: Women who are successfully sterilized (including hysterectomy, bilateral salpingectomy, bilateral tubal occlusion, or bilateral oophorectomy) or postmenopausal (defined as amenorrhea for at least 12 consecutive months and \>50 years of age or in the documented clinical opinion of a Women's Health Specialist) are not considered to be WOCBP for study purposes.
5. Males with a partner of childbearing potential must use a condom for the duration of treatment and for at least 48 hours after discontinuing study drug.

Exclusion Criteria:

1. Pregnant or lactating
2. Use of any other investigational drug/device or participation in any investigational study in which the participant received a medical intervention (ie, procedure, device, medication/supplement). Participation in non-interventional, observational, or registry studies is permitted.
3. Developed a concurrent illness or condition when using treprostinil SMI for PH-COPD in a previous study, which, in the opinion of the Investigator, would represent a risk to their overall health if they enrolled in this study.
